about: The tool-round budget of one turn, the same in both SDKs (2026-09-28): the default and the bounds, the round at which the model is told to stop calling tools (half way through a budget of 20 or less, 80% of a larger one), the words the model gets, the reasons a turn ends with, and what the chat asks. A turn that reaches its budget, or makes the same tool call `repeat_limit` times, makes ONE more model call with tools off and a wrap-up message, so it always ends with an answer when the model gives one. `scenario` is a stub model that asks for a tool whenever it has tools, run under a budget of `limit`; `loop` one that repeats a call. Python: webagents/agents/core/tool_budget.py, tests/test_tool_round_budget.py; TypeScript: src/core/tool-budget.ts, tests/unit/core/tool-round-budget.test.ts.
warning: You have used {used}/{limit} of your tool-call budget for this response. Stop delegating and calling tools. Summarize what you have done so far and deliver the final answer to the user now. Do not start new workflows.
